notes.title: Some updates and bug fixes
notes.notes:
- Fixed a bug where it was possible to block the ball against the wall, which resulted in automatic bouncing from the mouse and counting an infinite number of points.
 - Repairing the physics of tapping lighter balls, which caused when the mouse touched a lying ball - it was thrown upwards with too high speed.
- Added dark background to tutorial windows - improved readability
- UI font changed to make it easier to read
